{{Top|leg}}
The '''diplomatic hostel''' was a building on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It provided both housing and a meeting ground for various [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] to Coruscant from worlds who were not in the New Republic, who ganted the building and its occupants full privacy.
